findings.issue: Qal infinitive absolute plus qal perfect 3ms has no reflexive, middle, or object pronoun; unmarked se adds a pronominal object (himself / became exalted).
Qal imperfect 3ms is rendered as the preterite cantó, closing the yiqtol to completed past.
Cohortative 1cs is rendered as plain future Cantaré, so the volitive force is not marked.
כי is marked only as a conjunction; porque fixes a causal reading.

notes: Singular caballo, doubled exalt- root, Jehová, and the quote’s 1cs match the tokens.
